description: This is the main CLI script for the universal project initializer. It handles command-line arguments, creates project configurations, retrieves template initialization info, and outputs JSON results. It provides functionality to initialize various project types and to fetch the command to run specific project setups.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated parameter string into a dictionary with typed values.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig object for retrieving template info, given a project type and optional parameters.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a given base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary with absolute paths for init files.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Outputs a JSON-formatted result indicating success or failure, along with message and template info.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a specific project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the retrieval of the run command for a given project type using CLI arguments.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function that parses CLI arguments, executes project initialization or get-run-command logic.

ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
